nameOfQualification: Certificate in Visual Effects and Production
description: Developed in collaboration with Maya Entertainment Studios Private Limited, the role focuses on advanced skills in visual effects, compositing, motion graphics, and digital content production. It emphasizes layer-based and node-based compositing, 2D/3D tracking, green screen techniques, and integration of computer-generated elements into live-action footage. The candidate will also gain exposure to dynamics simulation, generative AI tools, and advanced animation projects. The qualification includes essential employability skills to support professional communication, collaboration, and project-based learning. A sound understanding of digital tools and creative workflows is required for effective functioning in the media, entertainment, and design industry.
